[/size][/font]
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Installation:[/size][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Install all their required mods.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Unzip, and you will get a [color=#ff7700]PNG[/color] image named '[color=#ff7700]wineryextra[/color].'[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Place this image into [size=3][color=#ff7700]Stardew Valley\Mods[/color][/size][color=#ff7700]\[size=3][CP] Buildable Winery\assets[/size][/color]. When it asks if you want to [/size][color=#ff7700][size=5]replace[/size][/color][size=3] the image, please click 'Yes.' [/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=5]You need to replace the picture manually[/size][size=3].[/size][/color][/font]
[/list]
